name: Voxel Face Culling with Chunked Rendering Order
definition: Generates mesh faces for solid voxels only when adjacent to an empty voxel or chunk boundary, iterating chunks in a camera-relative front-to-back order to optimize GPU depth sorting.
summary: Voxel Face Culling with Chunked Rendering Order optimizes blocky voxel mesh rendering by generating geometry only for faces adjacent to empty space or chunk boundaries, traversing chunks in camera-relative front-to-back order to improve GPU depth sorting efficiency.
